models_evaluated: XGBoost (Extreme Gradient Boosting) hospital admission prediction models

links.outcome: Proportion of ED patients with correct and potentially unnecessary medication reconciliation before vs after admission-prediction prioritization dashboard
links.effect: Correct MR rose from 86.4% to 89.0% (p = 0.0002); potentially unnecessary MR fell from 17.9% to 12.6% (p < 0.0001).
links.quote: After implementing the dashboard, the proportion of patients with correct MR increased from 86.4 to 89.0% (p = 0.0002), and the proportion of patients with potentially unnecessary MR decreased from 17.9 to 12.6% (p < 0.0001).

screen.reason: Evaluates the real-world operational impact of deploying an AI dashboard to prioritize medication reconciliation in an ED using a before-after design.
